programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship! - Delon And Nikki
programme.desc: Delon was head over heels about Nikki for years, but over time they lost touch; 17 years later they've reunited, and Delon feels like the luckiest man alive; he wants to marry Nikki, but the only problem is, she's hiding him.

programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship! - Frankie And Erin
programme.desc: After two years of dating, Frankie is ready to embark on a life-changing adventure with Erin; he plans to move into a bus and live a minimalist lifestyle with her, but first he needs to know why Erin is hiding him from everyone in her life.

programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship! - Nick And Joey
programme.desc: Joey and Nick fell in love in Florida, and they moved to California to fulfill Nick's dream of owning his own business and to be closer to his family; but a year has passed and Joey still hasn't met Nick's family, and he's demanding answers.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show - Steven And Samm
programme.desc: Rather than plan for college, a young man wants to move to California to support his online love, but his mother is skeptical.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show - Erika And Jermaine
programme.desc: Erika fell in love with Jermaine as he supported her through the toughest time in her life, but after three years of dating, he's remained cagey about meeting; a look at whether Nev and Kamie can help Erika uncover the secret Jermaine is hiding.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show - Brittany And Bryon
programme.desc: A single mother finds love online with a Marine who soon may go to Iraq again, so she wants to meet him before time runs out.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show - Anthony and Marq
programme.desc: Anthony, an Iraq War veteran, connects with an emotionally available man; Marq has been telling some troubling lies.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show - Spencer And Katy
programme.desc: Spencer reveals that he has been having a relationship with a pop star, and the Catfish team sets out to find the truth.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show - Dorion And Jeszica
programme.desc: Two women tear Dorion apart: his current girlfriend Raffinee, and his online love of over two years, Jessica; Dorion is willing to give up everything for Jessica, including his relationship with Raffinee.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show - Paris And Tara
programme.desc: Paris wants to know who has been catfishing her for four years, but Nev and Max make a discovery that casts suspicion on Paris.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show - Lucas And Many
programme.desc: When Jayme learns that her online boyfriend is fake and that he is catfishing other women as well, she enlists the help of Nev and Max to stop him.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show - Jarrod And Abby
programme.desc: Jarrod never thought he'd find love-until he fell for Abby on Facebook; Jarrod thinks Abby could be the one, but she's refusing to see him.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show - Brendan And McKenna
programme.desc: Failed attempts to connect with his love leave a man wondering if she is real.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show - Trina And Scorpio
programme.desc: Trina is an exotic dancer who always had trouble meeting guys she could trust, until she met Scorpio, a fellow dancer, online.

programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show - Double or Nothing
programme.desc: A heartbroken Jamie (Jamie Foxx) has a romantic encounter with a woman (guest star Golden Brooks) who resembles his ex-girlfriend Fancy (Garcelle Beauvais).

programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show - Serve No Wine Before I Get Mine
programme.desc: Jamie (Jamie Foxx) is swindled by a music producer (Ed Lover) who steals the love song he wrote for Fancy (Garcelle Beauvais).

programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show - Shades of Gray
programme.desc: Jamie and Fancy's (Jamie Foxx, Garcelle Beauvais) fledgling friendship founders because they can't stay out of the bedroom.

programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show - I'll Do It My Dammy.com
programme.desc: While Jamie recoils from selling his soul to a big record label, he has a nightmare inspired by The Matrix.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros. - Blood Is Thicker Than Watercolor
programme.desc: When Marlon (Marlon Wayans) is mistaken for a rising artist, his head swells until Lou (Jill Tasker) bursts his bubble.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros. - Two Men and a Baby
programme.desc: Shawn and Marlon (Shawn and Marlon Wayans) find a baby on their doorstep with a note claiming one of them is the father.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros. - Loot
programme.desc: Shawn and Marlon (Shawn and Marlon Wayans) find $100,000 stashed in a garbage bag and debate its destiny.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros. - The Liars Club
programme.desc: Marlon (Marlon Wayans) tells Monique (Paula Jai Parker) his true feelings about her while she's pretending to be married to Shawn (Shawn Wayans).

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos - Alfonso's Flubs, Kid Vids, and Exercise Your Right to Fall Down
programme.desc: Nine finalists go head-to-head for a $100,000 prize; twin boys are forced to share a soda; a girl's makeup tutorial gets messy; a boy helps his mom compose the cutest grocery list ever; a boy is horrified to learn sucking on markers can be hazardous.

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos - Grand Prize Spectacular, Alfonso's Funny Videos, and Family Time
programme.desc: Alfonso's funniest home videos; a little girl who is enthralled with her new whoopee cushion; a compilation of the hazards of winter.

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos - Winter Blunderland, Prank You Very Much, and #NotTrending
programme.desc: Funny pranks; a musical tribute to cats; a deer steals the carrot nose from a snowman.

programme.title: Rápidos y furiosos 9

programme.title: Jurassic World: Dominio

programme.title: Alerta extrema
programme.desc: El piloto Brodie Torrance salva a los pasajeros de la aeronave de un accidente al realizar un aterrizaje forzoso en una isla en guerra. Los rebeldes toman a todos como rehenes, y solo Torrance y un pasajero, un asesino, pueden salvarlos.

programme.title: Baywatch: Guardianes de la bahía
programme.desc: Dos socorristas, el veterano Mitch Buchannon y el joven y arrogante Matt Brody, deben detener a unos criminales que amenazan el futuro de la bahía en la que trabajan. Mientras colaboran aprenderán a respetarse mutuamente, algo no siempre sencillo.

programme.title: Un inesperado cuento de Navidad

programme.title: Coraline y la puerta secreta

programme.title: Legalmente rubia

programme.title: Johnny English 3.0
